entities.summary: Serhii Viacheslavovych Sternenko is a Ukrainian activist, lawyer, and YouTuber. As of 2025, his YouTube channel has over 2.03 million subscribers. He is the head of the non-government organization Nebayduzhi, one of the founders of the People's Lustration, and a former board member and head of the Odesa regional branch of Right Sector, a coalition of right-wing groups that includes ultranationalist and far-right elements. He was an active participant in the Revolution of Dignity, including the 2014 Odesa clashes.
